+title: 'SF Symbols: one symbol table with current names, one symbol for each concept'
+---
+## What
+An audit on 2026-10-11 found that the symbol names are spread over many views, that six names are old names that macOS 27 renamed, and that one concept has different symbols in different views. Paths are below `Sources/AgentViewKit/`.
+
+## Work
+- [ ] Put each SF Symbol name of the kit in one place (extend `ToolKindSymbol` / `ToolStatusSymbol` in `Items/ToolKindSymbol.swift`, or add one symbol table). The views read the names from it.
+- [ ] Change the old names to the current macOS 27 names: `arrow.triangle.2.circlepath` (`Items/ToolKindSymbol.swift:23`), `clock.arrow.circlepath` (`Status/SessionStreamBanner.swift:146`), `doc.on.clipboard` (`Items/MessageActions.swift:75`), `doc.richtext` (`Attachments/ArtifactView.swift:44`), `largecircle.fill.circle` (`Elicitation/ElicitationFieldViews.swift:632`), and `doc`, `doc.text`, `doc.on.doc`, `mic`, `mic.slash`, `terminal`.
+- [ ] Use one symbol for each concept: error (`xmark.octagon.fill` against `exclamationmark.triangle.fill` and the outline triangle), cancelled (`slash.circle`, `xmark.circle`, `stop.circle.fill`), pending (`hourglass` against `circle`), and the diff edit row (`pencil` against the `.square` symbols in `Diff/DiffView.swift:174-181`).
+- [ ] The switch-mode tool kind and the max-turn-requests banner (`Status/StateBanner.swift:208`) must not show the same symbol.
+- [ ] Tests: each name in the table exists, no name is an old renamed name, and two different concepts do not share a symbol. Cover the banners, the stop reasons, the plan, the diff, the command output, the message actions and the send state.
\ No newline at end of file
